_: STANDARDS — read this family as a recovery organisation reading itself against what good looks like. The frame, spine:standards, holds CLERO's 33 National LERO Standards in CLERO's own words. Each person's reading of where Community Recovery stands on a standard is in their own block, standards:<name>, at the standard's own address. The combined picture is kept at the bare name, standards, as dated minutes, so that where we stood can be set beside where we stand. No scores and no totals: a standard nobody has spoken to is not yet spoken, never a failure, and where readings differ they are shown differing.

1._: THE FRAME — each standard is CLERO's statement with its number, and the number is what joins this place's readings to any other recovery organisation's. The lines above the standards name CLERO's four sections and, inside the two long ones, small clusters. Sections A and B apply to every lived experience recovery organisation; C and D apply once one is constituted.
1.1: What meeting a standard looks like, its criteria and its example evidence, is CLERO's to say and is read in CLERO's own document at https://www.clero.co.uk/clero-standards. It is pointed to from here, never copied.

2._: A READING — write at a standard's address only your own reading of where Community Recovery stands on it, leading with one of three words, Spoken, Partly or Not yet, each said beneath, then what is in place, what is not there yet, and what would show it. Silence is not-yet-read. A reading is its writer's to change or remove, and nobody else's.
2.1: Spoken — Community Recovery already says or does this.
2.2: Partly — some of it is in place.
2.3: Not yet — it is not in place, or not yet said.

3: THE ROOM — pool:standards is for talk about the standards as a whole. A reading of one standard belongs in the reader's own block at that standard.

4._: THE PICTURE — the circle beside each standard is drawn from every open reading of it each time the page opens: whole when all who read it say Spoken, half where some say Partly, open where someone says Not yet or nobody has written, and split where readings differ. Beneath: a person's own synthesis, the shared picture kept by the keepers as dated minutes, and Matthew's first reading, which stands on the apex beach at community-recovery-standards:Phenomemental and is read beside the readings made here.
4.1: A person's own synthesis stands in tree:standards:<name>, theirs alone.
4.2: The shared picture is kept at the bare name, standards, at a standard's address or a section's: a dated minute by a keeper, saying what the readings hold in common, where they differ and what would move it, in the readers' own words.
4.3: Matthew's first reading of all 33, written on 29 September 2026 from the constitution draft and the membership form, stands on the apex beach at community-recovery-standards:Phenomemental, at these same addresses, and is read beside the readings made here.

5: WHERE IT MEETS THE CONSTITUTION — a reading that finds the draft constitution silent on a standard becomes, in the same person's own words, a Change at the clause it concerns, in constitution:<name>. Nothing else joins the two families.
9: PROVENANCE — written 30 September 2026 by weft at David Pinto's word. The frame is CLERO's. The clusters, the three words and the three things a reading says are Matthew's, from spine:community-recovery-standards and his own reading on the apex beach. The shape is the family form. Nothing here was written by Community Recovery or by CLERO, and nothing here speaks for either.
